info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Details-v4-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Details API provides comprehensive access to information about available pets for adoption. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve detailed profiles of pets, including their characteristics, background, and adoption status. Ideal for animal shelters, adoption agencies, or pet enthusiasts, this API supports use cases such as pet search applications and adoption management systems. Users can leverage this data to enhance pet visibility and facilitate successful adoptions.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific pet.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific pet by its unique identifier. The details include attributes like name, age, breed, and health status, providing comprehensive insights into each pet's profile.
